failure.heading: 33. A command that writes was run to read — 2026-10-11

observed_failure.description: In one maintenance command episode the assistant lists due straw dogs, then runs bare questions.py --wake to display them, creating an extra session.

events.text:
Bash {"command": "uv run --offline --no-project python .agents/scripts/gw/straw_dogs.py docs AGENTS.md local.rules.md .agents README.md 2>&1 | PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 uv run --offline --no-project python -c "
import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=d['statements']
print(len(s)); print(s[0].keys() if s else '')
due=[x for x in s if x.get('due') or x.get('state')=='due']
print('due',len(due)); [print(x.get('path'),x.get('line'),x.get('question')) for x in due]
"; uv run --offline --no-project python .agents/scripts/gw/questions.py --wake 2>/dev/null | sed -n '/straw dogs due/,/^$/p'", "description": "Count straw dogs and read which the wake reports due", "timeout": 300000}
